blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two examinees from Cebu landed among the topnotchers for the October 2026 Fisheries Professional Licensure Examination (FPLE). Janna Ejurango Taboada of Cebu Technological University-Moalboal ranked sixth, with an 88.25 percent rating. Meanwhile, Niño Balmera Aro of Cebu Technological University-Carmen ranked eighth with an 87.75 percent rating. READ: 2 Cebuanos earn top spots in civil engineering board exam The FPLE was conducted on October 1–2, 2026, in all testing centers nationwide.
